title: OneSMP
description: Survival Minecraft Server built by EliteNK.
body:
Welcome to OneSMP!
A World Worth Returning to. Est. Jan 2025

OneSMP is a persistent Vanilla+ crossplay Survival Server with land claims, player shops, public warps, and a fair no-pay-to-win economy. Build, trade, explore, take part in community projects, and make progress that lasts.

🌍 Persistent Survival
A long-term world with daily backups, play knowing your work will last!

✨ Server Modpack
Play with our optional Modrinth pack, designed to smooth performance and polish gameplay without changing the feel of Minecraft.

⚒️ Hybrid Economy
Jobs, player shops, and limited admin shops create a balanced market where supply and demand keep trade alive.

🛡️ Community-Driven
GriefPrevention, Simple Voice Chat, and feedback-shaped development keep the server fair and fun.

🤝 Tight-Knit, Player-Driven Community
OneSMP is actively developed with feedback from a small but thoughtful player base. Your ideas help shape the server!

Java & Bedrock crossplay supported.
Join us and help build something worth coming back to.
